description:
Description of specific Duties in a typical workday for this position:
 Write code across the full application stack – front end Web UI, middle tier service layer, and back end database
 Perform analysis of requirements and design
 Create and execute unit tests and perform basic systems testing
 Participate in peer code reviews and technical meetings
 Work in an Agile Scrum team process, collaborating closely with fellow developers, DBAs, QA, team leads, and stakeholders
 Troubleshoot and support system and application problems
 

 Position Requirements: 
 US Citizen.
 NACI (Clearance).
 Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent work experience.
 Five (5) + years of experience using Microsoft technologies including ASP.NET 4.0, C#/VB.NET and Windows Server 2008 R2 with IIS 7.5.
 Experience with Oracle 11g.
 Excellent understanding of Object Oriented software design.
 Excellent knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, CSS, SQL, and Web Services.
 Experience with Agile development processes, methodologies, and tools.
 Aptitude and desire to learn new technologies.
 Comfortable working independently and in a team environment.
 
 Nice to Have: 
 DoD Secret Clearance.
 Visual Studio 2010+ preferred.
 Experience with Crystal Reports.
 Experience with the Telerik ASP.Net Library.
 Experience with web frameworks like jQuery, Bootstrap, Knockout, SASS, etc.
 Experience with Node.js and related web-dev tools (Bower, Grunt, Gulp, Yeoman, Jasmine, etc)
 Experience with distributed source control systems (preferably Git).
 Understanding of Test Driven Development.
 Microsoft Certification related to .NET technologies.
 Security+ Certification.
 This is a full-time position paying a base salary, full benefits, and has possible bonus potential based on merit and performance

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
